readerUnjoinedAtWait.text: A goroutine reads the {{stream}} pipe, and `{{wait}}` is reached on some path here before that goroutine is joined. `{{wait}}` closes the pipe once the child exits, so the goroutine can lose the end of the output. Join it first, with a `sync.WaitGroup`'s `Wait` or a receive from a channel it closes when it is done, then call `{{wait}}`.
